name: SQLite Backup
description: Create and restore backups of a SQLite database.
project_description:
With SQLite Backup a site administrator can create backups of the SQLite database and restore them.

 Features 
 Usually Drupal sites do not run on SQLite. But SQLite is very useful for its simplicity, for example the drupal launcher. This module allows to create backups of the SQLite database file and restore them.

 Post-Installation 
 The modules backup overview page can be used to manage the SQLite backups.

 Additional Requirements 
 This module only works when the SQLite database driver is used.

 Recommended modules/libraries 
 This module was developed to enhance the Drupal CMS experience when used in the desktop launcher.

 Similar projects 
 
 Config Checkpoint UI allows to restore the configuration to an older checkpoint. But SQLite Backup manages backups of the entire database. 
 DDEV snapshots allows to manage database snapshots just like this module, but requires ddev and the CLI 
 
 Supporting this Module 
 Please get in contact with the module author for the best way to provide support.
